scope: Expert Mission 17 Spirit Sword reward identity conflict resolution

records.name: Spirit Sword
evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation identifies Spirit Sword as a Strike Ultimate, 400 Ki, unlocked from Expert Mission 17 — In the Realm of the Gods: Goku.
The current Xenoverse 2 Expert Mission list independently identifies EM17 as rewarding Spirit Sword.
Dragon Ball reference material independently states that in Xenoverse 2 Spirit Sword is obtained by the Future Warrior as a reward in Expert Mission 17.
A launch-era Steam discussion explicitly distinguishes Super Spirit Bomb as EM16 and Spirit Sword as EM17, providing contemporaneous acquisition corroboration.
An independent Expert Mission guide contains an EM17 Spirit Bomb naming line; this is retained as historical conflicting evidence rather than promoted over the direct Spirit Sword evidence.

promoted_fields.mission_title: In the Realm of the Gods: Goku

limits: No numerical drop probability or first-clear guarantee is inferred.

The older all-Expert-Missions guide's EM17 Spirit Bomb label is preserved as historical source conflict; it is not treated as the current reward identity because multiple direct/current and contemporaneous sources identify Spirit Sword.
No canonical skills.json or skills-index.json reconstruction/promotion was performed; the existing canonical Spirit Sword identity and Strike Ultimate taxonomy are unchanged.

evidence_boundary: Batch 336 resolves the EM17 reward-name research boundary in favor of the already-canonical Spirit Sword identity using current Xenoverse 2 skill/mission references plus independent corroboration. The contradictory historical EM17 Spirit Bomb label remains documented as source history; no drop probability, guarantee, or unsupported canonical rewrite is introduced.
